summary: This article explains how cities invite artists to plan and paint huge murals on blank walls, turning quiet streets in places like Riyadh and Jeddah into colorful public landmarks.
introduce: Show the title “Street Art and Murals” and give pairs one minute to list everything they already know about this topic. Share a few ideas on the board, then tell students to check which ideas the article confirms.

keyTerms.def: a group of people who live in the same area
a plan or drawing that shows how something will look
official agreement that allows someone to do something

challengeTerms.def: the colored substance mixed into paint or dye
to change something completely into something different
full of bright, lively color or energy

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that painting a big, colorful mural is a good way to use a blank city wall? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Imagine your school asked you to help plan a mural for a blank wall. Describe the theme you would choose and explain how you would get permission and help from your community.
struggling: Read the first part of the article aloud together, review community, design, and permission, and let weak readers use a K-W-L chart and read the article with a partner.
gifted: Challenge advanced readers to use pigment, transform, and vibrant in a short paragraph that connects the article to something they learned in another subject.
